literal: Even when the support of those who possess the earth is obtained, for those who possess laziness, attaining great benefits is rare.
translation: Even if they secure the support of the rulers of the earth, those who are lazy will find it impossible to attain great benefits.
modern: உலகத்தை ஆளுபவர்களின் ஆதரவைப் பெற்றிருந்தாலும், சோம்பல் உடையவர்கள் சிறந்த நன்மைகளை அடைவது அரிது.
explanation: This couplet highlights how laziness completely neutralizes even the greatest external advantages. The word 'படி' refers to the earth, and 'படியுடையார்' means the rulers of the earth, representing the highest possible source of power and support. 'பற்று' denotes support or alliance. The poet argues that even if a person secures the backing of such powerful rulers, they cannot achieve any great or lasting benefits ('மாண்பயன்') if they are plagued by laziness ('மடி'). Ultimately, personal effort and activity are indispensable, and no amount of external patronage can compensate for sloth.
